description: Habiro coefficient analysis: the deuteron binding scale 5.85 decomposes as dim(V_{(2,1)}) × lw_A × (1 + higher Habiro corrections). a_0(D) = 32 = 4×4×2 = a_0(p)×a_0(n)×dim(V_{(2,1)}). Leading term: 2 × 2.533 = 5.07 (13% off). Residual 13% = higher-order Habiro motivic corrections at jet orders m≥1.

data.residual_source: higher-order Habiro terms (motivic corrections at jet m>=1)
data.conclusion: The Geom linking weight for binding = dim(V_{std}) × lw_A_proton × (1+Habiro tower). The Habiro integer structure constrains the tower to integer polynomial corrections. Closing the 13% = computing the first few Habiro higher-order terms for the deuteron.
